hypothesis: Joint end-to-end classification optimization can change intermediate task representations while preserving the released complete classifier. This differs from independent teacher-block regression and from last-block recovery gradients. It is a fixed mechanism-transfer control, not an asserted new defense.
objective: CE on fixed original expert synthetic labels minus lambda/s times CE after public-base task scaling. lambda=.005 is the official full-tuning README example, no grid or test selection. All 12 MLP A/B weights and B biases update together; A affine bias is differentiated through and reconstructed. Other parameters remain fixed. A finite updates are projected outside rank32 task left/right subspaces. A/B limits remain2/4 per matrix; affine biases are tied and output bias changes recorded without an added cap. No per-step all-view correctness veto or hidden-vector reconstruction.
differences_from_paper: Starts from the fixed protected expert instead of pretraining weights; no real training images or labels. 160 existing synthetic images and their five fixed views. Only A/B modules vary; task-SVD projection is added. Short200steps, no validation selection or early stopping; last point of both conditions retained. Therefore not an official Trap2 reproduction or evidence of original algorithmic novelty.
computation: Two fixed 200-step constructions, each native and scaled forward, fixed seed/order. Original expert and public base frozen. No partner/test/counterexample construction. Both points frozen before any test image. No automatic modification after evaluation.
evaluation: First record all800source classifications and parameter changes. For both fixed points evaluate complete MNIST native, real TA.5 and originalAGA target-only/both with SVHN, then same fixed64-per-task ProDistill/100stepsperblock. Report native failures and target/partner results; do not select best condition as replacement or extend to new tasks without assessing mechanism. Independent comparison before claims.

reference.method: Native/scaled CE objective; AdamW betas(.9,.98),eps1e-6; paperfull lr1e-4; scale.05..2 excluding.95..1.05; w(s)=1/s. Weightdecay0 to avoid changing SVD restrictions by regularizer.
